summary.zh: 设计 Jira 与 Confluence 模板
summary.en: Create reusable Jira and Confluence templates and page layouts.

description.zh: 为组织制作和维护可复用的模板、蓝图与页面布局，统一会议纪要、项目章程、PRD、决策记录等文档的结构。适合梳理标准文档、收拢散落的各种写法时使用。需要在目标空间或项目中发布模板的权限。
description.en: Builds reusable Jira and Confluence templates, blueprints and page layouts so meeting notes, charters, PRDs and decision logs share one structure. Useful when document formats have drifted. Needs publish rights in the target space.
